info.title: Atlas implemented HCM API
info.description: Implemented Phase 1 and Phase 2 subsets only. Server directory/inbox/position search and pagination; legacy employee/request arrays and department/audit reference limits are documented per endpoint. Server-resolved tenant, cookie sessions, CSRF and no-store sensitive responses. Core HR decision replay returns 409; benefits identical decision replay returns its existing result. Stable creation/submission replay returns its existing result.

emergencyContactPhone.description: Private field: null when record access permits reading but field access is denied; empty string when not provided.

newValue.description: Empty string removes an optional address/emergency value or unassigns the primary position. Null/whitespace and blank required fields are invalid. Position/departments must align at proposed and approved future dates; audit retained.

fieldErrors.description: Optional server-owned validation messages keyed by form field; never echoes submitted values.
